title: Thai satellites panel: stale "tracking comes with the next phase" copy; link to Real satellites (Thai group); THEOS-2A check

status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/i18n/en.ts:1440 use.thai.nominal still says "Following real satellites comes with the Orbit section's next phase" (same in th.ts:1417, ru.ts:1416) although R02 Real satellites with a Thai group shipped; no Real-satellites button in applications-panel.ts. THEOS-2A presence not checked.

title: Applications keep stale Thai-satellite identity/repeat grid after preset or slider change; NAPA-2 case not marked stale on data-mode change
title_th: แผงการใช้งาน: รหัสดาวเทียมไทยและตาราง repeat ค้างหลังเปลี่ยน preset/วงโคจร และกรณี NAPA-2 ไม่ถูกทำเครื่องหมายว่าล้าสมัยเมื่อเปลี่ยนโหมดข้อมูล
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: thaiId is cleared only by handoffEntry() (src/orbit/playground-model.ts:117); choosePreset() (src/ui/orbit/playground.ts:373-385) and slider setOrbit() do not reset it, while eoReport() still uses thai?.repeat?.revs (playground.ts:806-810). acceptance: Unit test in tests/orbit-playground.test.ts: showThai(id) then choosePreset / slider edit -> apps.thaiId === null and eoReport repeat input null; NAPA-2 slot keyed on data mode like caseStudy (caseInputs) so a mode switch shows "stale"; existing hand-off test (lines 291-297) unchanged.

title: Watch tour shows the LEO period after a Hohmann burn to GEO; sky step says "ISS is here now" while warp shows "Not now"
title_th: ทัวร์ระดับ Watch แสดงคาบโคจร LEO ค้างหลังเผาไหม้ Hohmann ไป GEO และขั้นท้องฟ้าบอก "ISS อยู่ตรงนี้ตอนนี้" ขณะเร่งเวลาแสดง "ไม่ใช่ตอนนี้"
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: renderTour() writes the period stat once (src/ui/orbit/playground.ts:1307); on a segment change frame() calls renderFacts() (:545-548) which returns immediately at Watch level (:1157), so the tour card keeps the first segment's period (transfer 10 h 37 min or LEO 1 h 34 min beside 35,786 km). Orbit files untouched by R2.
placement: B (B-ORBIT-1)
priority_rationale: Wrong number on the beginner (Watch) path, the level with the least ability to notice it.

Unit/DOM test: fly the Hohmann tour step to after burn 2 -> period equals orbitFacts(GEO).period text. Sky step wording keyed to actual visibility at the current warp time.

title: Screening/re-entry worker failures shown as "Screening stopped" or silently cleared (AbortError not separated from real errors)
title_th: ความล้มเหลวของ worker คัดกรองการเข้าใกล้/การกลับเข้าบรรยากาศ ถูกแสดงเป็น "หยุดแล้ว" หรือถูกล้างเงียบ ๆ
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/ui/orbit/sky-panel.ts:960-962 `catch { ... slot.clear(); }` for re-entry; :1190 `catch { list = null; }` then slot.stop(gen) for screening; ResultSlot has no fail path used in ui/orbit (grep finds no `.fail(`).
placement: B (B-ORBIT-1), built on the shared job runner of code-review D1
priority_rationale: Users and teachers cannot tell "you cancelled" from "it broke"; a failed 30k-object screening reads as a deliberate stop.
acceptance: AbortError -> "stopped"; any other error -> localized failure text with reason and Retry (EN/TH/RU); fake-worker unit tests for screening and re-entry error paths; browser journey cancels and forces a worker error.
quality_guard: Keep recheck partial-on-stop and readiness supersede semantics untouched (D1 (C)); no change to computed results.
user_benefit: Clear, honest feedback when a long analysis fails, with a way to retry.

title: Re-entry/lifetime/altitude inline (no-worker) fallback runs synchronously: Stop impossible and a cancelled run can resolve as a truncated "finished" result
title_th: เส้นทางสำรองที่ไม่ใช้ worker ของงานกลับเข้าบรรยากาศ/อายุวงโคจร ทำงานแบบ synchronous กด Stop ไม่ได้ และผลที่ถูกยกเลิกอาจแสดงเป็นผลสมบูรณ์
sources: CR:D1(B) inline-fallback part (owned by bundle group)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/orbit/reentry-job.ts:59-63 `setTimeout(() => resolve(predictFromRequest(req, (f) => { onProgress(f); return !signal.aborted; })), 0)` -> abort breaks the propagation and resolves a partial answer; no pre-aborted check before new Worker (D1).
placement: B, executed inside the D1 worker-job package (bundle group); orbit owner reviews the orbit job wrappers
priority_rationale: Correctness: a truncated lifetime/re-entry can be displayed as a final answer.
depends_on: CR:P2 decision (module-worker format) only affects how often this path runs
acceptance: Inline-fallback abort rejects with AbortError; pre-aborted signal creates no worker; fake-worker tests per job (lifetime, reentry, lifetime-altitude, requirement-trades); UI shows "cancelled", never a partial result.
quality_guard: Do not add a blanket main-thread fallback for long jobs (would freeze the page); recheck partial-on-stop stays as designed.
user_benefit: A cancelled analysis is never mistaken for a completed one.

title: Long March 5B and NAPA-2 re-entry case studies run on the main thread (about 1.3 s and 0.6 s freezes, no Stop)
title_th: กรณีศึกษา Long March 5B และ NAPA-2 คำนวณบน main thread (ค้างราว 1.3 วินาทีและ 0.6 วินาที กดหยุดไม่ได้)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/ui/orbit/sky-panel.ts:968-995 runNapaCase/runCaseStudy call predictReentry() directly (4 stages x predictReentry) after await sun().
placement: E (identical-output efficiency; reuse reentry.worker via the D1 runner)
priority_rationale: Visible page freeze in the sky panel on low-end school devices; identical results moved off-thread.
acceptance: Case studies run through runReentryJob (or a batch message) with progress and Stop; Object.is equality of every row (predicted window, B, actual) against the current main-thread call for the fixed CZ-5B/NAPA-2 inputs; long-task count during "Run" drops to 0 in the perf journey.
quality_guard: Same function and inputs in the worker -> bit-identical numbers; keep the stale/fresh slot semantics.

title: Catalogue load state: Watch tour real-satellite steps blank while loading/failed; no Retry after a failed load; online mode fetches once per page
title_th: สถานะโหลดแคตตาล็อก: ขั้นทัวร์ดาวเทียมจริงว่างเปล่าระหว่างโหลด/ล้มเหลว ไม่มีปุ่มลองใหม่ และโหมดออนไลน์ดึงข้อมูลครั้งเดียวต่อหน้า
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: sky-panel.ts load() (:206-226) runs once; only caseInput() (:243) resets "failed" to idle; :492 shows sky.failed text with no Retry control; tour (playground.ts renderTour :1278-1293) shows no stats and no loading/failure text when liveNow() is null.

priority_rationale: Silent empty steps on the first-screen Watch tour when offline data is slow or a fetch fails.

quality_guard: Retry must go through DataProvider so the CelesTrak at-most-once-per-2-h rule and snapshot fallback stay intact (RM:P3c).
user_benefit: Learners always see why a step is empty and can recover without reloading.

title: Repeat-ground-track tool accepts invalid input (0, empty, 14.5 revolutions) and answers "no circular orbit"
title_th: เครื่องมือ repeat ground track รับค่าที่ไม่ถูกต้อง (0, ว่าง, 14.5 รอบ) แล้วตอบว่า "ไม่มีวงโคจรวงกลม"
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: playground.ts repeatTool() :1057-1090 sets r.revs = Number(i.value) on change with no integer/range validation; repeatGroundTrack failure text pg.rep.none is reused for invalid input.
placement: B (B-ORBIT-1)
priority_rationale: Misleading physics answer for a typing mistake in an Engineer tool.
depends_on: CR:D9 (locale decimal entry decision for orbit/dom.ts Field, UI group)
acceptance: Non-integer/out-of-range/empty input shows a field-level validation message (3 languages) and keeps the last valid value; "no orbit" only for valid N/D with no solution; unit test over 0, NaN, 14.5, 501, 61.
quality_guard: Valid inputs give exactly the current answers.
user_benefit: Engineer-level users get an honest message for a typo instead of a wrong physics conclusion.

title: Military/SSA results: CSV export with input provenance; persist imported element/CDM files per profile
title_th: ผลด้าน SSA/ทหาร: ส่งออก CSV พร้อมแหล่งข้อมูลนำเข้า และเก็บไฟล์ element set/CDM ที่นำเข้าไว้ในโปรไฟล์
sources: RM:P3g(note: imported file kept only while page open)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: sky-panel.ts downloadBlob used only for case sheets (:1393); overflights capped at 40 rows of 242, conjunctions 20; imported TLE/OMM/CDM live only in memory (IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS Known limitations).
placement: T (teaching/institutional: cadet exercises) with storage part under the R1.1 profile contract

title: Create the Orbit playground's OrbitView (second WebGL context) only when the playground is shown
title_th: สร้าง OrbitView (WebGL context ที่สอง) ของหน้า Orbit เมื่อเปิดหน้านั้นจริงเท่านั้น
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: playground.ts render() :895 `if (this.view === '3d') this.ensureOrbitView()` is reached from the startup applyLanguage pass (applyLanguage :244-246 -> render) while hidden; perf baseline fbefa18 (orbit files unchanged in da67341): a webgl2 context on .pg-canvas is created at t~0.93 s, before the launch #gl context (t~1.69 s); "WebGL contexts to interactive = 2"; startup profile attributes ~110 ms self to src/render/orbit-view.ts (labelSprite, shared with the home globe).
placement: E (E-ORBIT-1 playground package); main.ts texture kick-off line by the I owner
priority_rationale: Measured startup waste on every load for a section many users never open; frees one WebGL context slot (Safari/iOS budget) before R3.2/R3.3 add previews.
depends_on: I-owner: keep an explicit early earthTextures ??= loadEarthTextures() in App construction
acceptance: webgl-startup journey counts 0 playground contexts before Orbit opens and 1 after; first-Orbit-frame screenshot pixel-equal to baseline; OrbitView call order syncGhosts -> setOrbit(framing) -> resize unchanged (incl. setHandoff while hidden); language switch while hidden then open -> correct text; Earth texture request start time not later (PerformanceResourceTiming); perf-baseline compare shows contexts-to-interactive 2 -> 1.
quality_guard: First Orbit open must not get slower by more than ~1 frame: optional requestIdleCallback pre-create after app.init; keep orbitViewFailed hint path; never drop the early texture fetch.
user_benefit: Faster, lighter startup (one fewer GPU context and less main-thread work) especially on phones and school tablets.
notes: Does not remove the measured ~4 s (SwiftShader) first-open long task (7 shader programs + 4096 texture upload into a second context); that needs the shared-renderer/context-budget work of CR:P21 (render group) before R3.2/R3.3.

title: Dirty-flag redraw for porkchop (always), paused ground track and (optional) paused 3-D view; cached colour strings
title_th: วาดใหม่เฉพาะเมื่อข้อมูลเปลี่ยน: porkchop ทุกสถานะ, ground track และมุม 3 มิติขณะหยุด

placement: E (E-ORBIT-1)
priority_rationale: Measured: a paused Orbit view burns as much CPU/GPU as a running one; battery and fan on laptops/phones in classrooms.
depends_on: CR:P23 shared Intl format cache (UI group) for porkchop num()
CR:P22 shared 2048 map image (render group, ground-track image onload must set dirty)
acceptance: Central markDirty() from every setter (set, hover, pointerleave, resize/DPR, language, visibility, contextrestored, map-image load); Playwright canvas.toDataURL equality after N frames incl. hover/resize/language/map load; porkchop draw-call log unchanged; best cell == porkchopMinimum on random grids with NaN/ties; perf-baseline orbitPaused renderer-main ms/s and draw calls drop well below orbitPlaying.
quality_guard: Full-quality repaint whenever any input changes; no offscreen-bitmap blit (resampling changes pixels); cannon view untouched (draw takes dt). 3-D paused skip only with complete camera-input invalidation, otherwise leave 3-D as is.
user_benefit: Reading a paused orbit or a porkchop plot no longer drains the battery; more headroom for typing and scrolling.

title: Applications results: update values in place instead of replacing the section 5 times per second; compute track overlay once per frame
title_th: ผลการใช้งาน (สื่อสาร/ถ่ายภาพ): อัปเดตค่าในที่เดิมแทนการสร้างส่วนใหม่ 5 ครั้งต่อวินาที

quality_guard: Same report strings from the same inputs; rebuild on time (playing), orbit/plan/j2, apps, level, language changes.

title: Passes and look angles: precompute station ECEF/ENU by value, compute the Sun direction and EOP/GMST once per sample

title: Lambert solver: 48 of 120 boundary cases return null without proof that no solution exists
title_th: ตัวแก้ Lambert: 48 จาก 120 กรณีขอบคืนค่า null โดยไม่มีหลักฐานว่าไม่มีคำตอบ

title: Finite-burn option in the maneuver planner (gravity loss beside the impulsive plan); out-of-plane rendezvous target
title_th: ตัวเลือกการเผาไหม้แบบใช้เวลา (finite burn) ในตัววางแผนการเปลี่ยนวงโคจร และเป้าหมายนัดพบนอกระนาบ
sources: OD:Orbit limits(part: impulsive burns, target always in chaser plane)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/orbit/maneuvers.ts burns impulsive only (no finite-burn/Robbins code in src/orbit or src/ui/orbit); IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS Known limitations: rendezvous target always in the chaser plane.
placement: F (F-ORBIT-2), after R5.2 so the ISS finite-transfer solver is reused, not duplicated
priority_rationale: Real realism gain but large; R5.2 builds the finite-transfer machinery first for ISS.
acceptance: Constant-thrust arc centred on the impulsive point with J2 coast; gravity loss shown beside the impulsive plan; Robbins 1966 loss within 10 %; Curtis section 6.10 GTO->GEO within 1 % delta-v; O03 propellant budget uses the finite arc when selected; impulsive default unchanged.
quality_guard: Opt-in: impulsive results and lessons that grade them stay byte-identical unless the user selects finite burns.
user_benefit: Students see why real burns cost more than the textbook impulsive answer.

title: Opt-in numerical (Cowell) propagation in Orbit Engineer alongside Kepler/SGP4
title_th: ตัวเลือกการคำนวณวงโคจรเชิงตัวเลข (Cowell) ในระดับ Engineer ของ Orbit
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: Orbit playground propagates Kepler + first-order J2 only; Cowell propagator exists for lifetime/re-entry (src/physics/propagator) but not as a playground option.
placement: F (F-ORBIT-2)
priority_rationale: Useful Engineer depth; depends on the propagator speed-ups and frame decisions first.
depends_on: CR:D18 Sun/Moon frame realism task (physics group)
acceptance: Engineer toggle "numerical (drag, J2-J4, Sun, Moon, SRP)" runs in a worker with progress/Stop; difference vs Kepler shown with the model named; validated against the propagator tests; default view unchanged.
quality_guard: Kepler default unchanged; worker only (no main-thread stall); labelled as a different model.
user_benefit: Engineer users can see drag decay and third-body effects in the same playground.

title: Re-entry/lifetime prediction accuracy: first-set criterion missed (33/66 within 20 %), two-set 79 % vs 80 % target, spheres 8-23 % early (NRLMSISE-00 bias), storm peaks averaged
title_th: ความแม่นของการทำนายการกลับเข้าบรรยากาศ/อายุวงโคจร: ไม่ผ่านเกณฑ์ที่ตั้งไว้ และ NRLMSISE-00 ทำนายเร็วเกิน 8-23%
status_evidence: IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS M03/R05 known limitations (recorded misses, criteria fixed before running); DEC D-10 still open in docs/DECISIONS.md "Still open" on origin/main da67341.
placement: F (F-ORBIT-3), physics-owner validation run shared with CR:D18/D19
priority_rationale: Honesty of a headline military-track result; blocked on an owner decision, so the decision is the near-term action.
depends_on: RW:PHY-12 one atmosphere above 100 km (physics group)
CR:D18/D19 (Sun frame, MU_MOON) same validation run
acceptance: Owner records D-10; then either NRLMSIS 2.1 port (NRL terms in NOTICE) or keep NRLMSISE-00 and show the measured -16 % bias at the number; re-run VALIDATION section R05/M03 with criteria unchanged and report before/after; 3-hourly Kp storm handling documented.
quality_guard: No empirical bias factor on the model (DP physics not-to-do list); criteria never loosened; lifetimes re-validated, not re-tuned to a single case.
user_benefit: Re-entry windows that are more often right, and an honest label when they are not.

title: R5.1 Make the existing Soyuz MS rendezvous/docking mission reachable and continuous; separate verdicts for insertion/rendezvous/capture/hard dock
title_th: R5.1 ทำภารกิจ Soyuz MS ไป ISS ที่มีอยู่ให้เข้าถึงได้และต่อเนื่องจนเชื่อมต่อ พร้อมผลแยกแต่ละขั้น
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: G07 docking exists (src/physics/rendezvous/*, 3 profiles, 4 ports, Kurs/TORU; tests/heavy/historical-docking.test.ts) but PROGRESS.md lists R3-R7 as Planned; Help still says "The ISS preset targets an approximate orbital plane, not rendezvous or docking." (src/ui/help-content.ts:38).
placement: PLAN R5.1
priority_rationale: Owner priority U06 (ISS mission to real docking); mostly exposes physics already built.
acceptance: As PLAN R5.1 plus: Help/inventory distinguish "ISS plane" missions from rendezvous missions; supported mission flies to `docked` in a browser journey; abort/retreat/fuel failure have real effect; replay of every phase equals recorded state.
quality_guard: Extend the existing G07 system (do not rebuild); warp/skip uses physical state (no teleport); orbit success never substitutes docking success.
user_benefit: Users can actually follow an ISS mission from launch to hard dock.

title: R5.2 ISS target orbit/phasing from a fixed-epoch reference state with provenance, then optional live ephemeris (SGP4/TEME frame contract)
title_th: R5.2 วงโคจรและเฟสของ ISS จากสถานะอ้างอิงที่ระบุแหล่ง แล้วจึงเลือกใช้ ephemeris จริง (สัญญา frame TEME)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/physics/mission.ts:156 ISS_RAAN0 = 200 deg propagated by issRaanAt() (:179-185) and used by src/orbit/presets.ts:28; no reference ISS state with provenance; SGP4/TLE/EOP/uncertainty modules exist (src/orbit/sgp4.ts, earth-orientation.ts, uncertainty.ts).
placement: PLAN R5.2
priority_rationale: Core realism of the ISS mission; must reuse the shipped real-sky stack instead of building a second one.
depends_on: CR:P14 propagator no-op speed-up before reuse (physics)
acceptance: As PLAN R5.2; frame contract TEME->ECI with UT1/polar motion from P2.5-b; live snapshot shows age/frame/model and R04 uncertainty; outside-window mission does not pretend success; reference cases with epoch/frame/tolerances fixed before running.
quality_guard: Deterministic reference mission kept for lessons/verification; do not re-phase initial geometry to make docking work; rendezvous targeting RK4 variants keep their own summation (CR:D15).
user_benefit: The ISS is where it really is (or labelled as a reference), and the phasing plan follows physics.

title: R5.3 Approach, fuel, sensing and contact dynamics (soft capture -> hooks -> hard dock, free drift, combined body)
title_th: R5.3 การเข้าใกล้ เชื้อเพลิง เซนเซอร์ และพลวัตการสัมผัส (soft capture -> hooks -> hard dock)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: R1.4 fuel invariants merged (docs/development/reports/R1.4-fuel.md); contact is pose capture with gates (no momentum exchange/free drift) per PLAN section 2.
placement: PLAN R5.3
priority_rationale: Physics credibility of the docking finale (U15).
acceptance: As PLAN R5.3 (zero fuel fails, collision is not success, isolated contact conserves momentum within tolerance, existing contact limits and failure cases re-checked).
quality_guard: No cinematic animation decoupled from physics; unknown stiffness/damping labelled estimate with sensitivity; no warp bypass of failures.
user_benefit: Docking succeeds or fails for physical reasons the learner can see.

title: R5.4 Ship/station/port visuals consistent with the contact model; Progress/Dragon expansion after the first validated mission
title_th: R5.4 ภาพยาน สถานี และพอร์ตที่ตรงกับแบบจำลองการสัมผัส และขยายไป Progress/Dragon หลังภารกิจแรกผ่าน
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: station/ship views exist (render/station.ts etc.); PLAN R5.4 not started (PROGRESS: R3-R7 Planned).
placement: PLAN R5.4
priority_rationale: Presentation after the physics of R5.2/R5.3; spacecraft expansion explicitly later (D02).
depends_on: CR:D25 Apollo view table refactor at R5.4 start (render group)
acceptance: As PLAN R5.4; renderer.info draw-call and screenshot diffs for any CR:P26/D22/D25 consolidation folded in.
quality_guard: Probe/port visuals equal contact geometry; replay never ahead of physics; no Soyuz values reused for Progress/Dragon.
user_benefit: What the learner sees at the port matches what the physics decides.

title: Owner decision PLAN-D07: realism target for the ISS mission (fixed historical ephemeris vs live snapshot with age/uncertainty; reference missions per vehicle)
title_th: การตัดสินใจ PLAN-D07: เป้าหมายความสมจริงของภารกิจ ISS (ephemeris อ้างอิงคงที่ หรือ snapshot จริงพร้อมอายุข้อมูลและความไม่แน่นอน)
status_evidence: PLAN.md v1.2 section 4.1: D01-D04 confirmed 2026-10-03; D07 not confirmed.
placement: PLAN R0.2 decision gate before R5.2
priority_rationale: Blocks R5.2 design; cheap to decide now.
acceptance: Decision recorded in DECISIONS.md with chosen reference missions/epochs and whether live snapshots are allowed in graded lessons.
quality_guard: Name collision: PLAN-D07 (this) is not ROADMAP D07 (requirements-driven satellite design) nor DEC D-7 (audio precache).
user_benefit: Clear, testable target for the ISS mission.

title: D-11 compliance: label the Moon "Apollo 11 week only (DE441)" where shown; fix README "the Moon itself is not modelled"
title_th: ทำตาม D-11: ติดป้าย "ดวงจันทร์เฉพาะสัปดาห์ของ Apollo 11 (DE441)" และแก้ README ที่บอกว่าไม่ได้จำลองดวงจันทร์
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: no "week only"/DE441 label in src/i18n/en.ts or src/ui (grep); README.md:131 "(the Moon itself is not modelled; ...)"; the constraint part holds: no Orbit tool references moonState/moonPosition (grep in src/ui, src/render/orbit-view.ts).

acceptance: Apollo Watch/lesson UI shows the ephemeris scope label in EN/TH/RU; README states the Apollo-week Moon; doc-number/claim test (if added by Q group) covers it.
quality_guard: Text only.
user_benefit: Learners and teachers know exactly where the Moon model is valid.

title: Re-scope ROADMAP Phase 5 text as "generalise #38" and retire the C05 name in code comments (keep ids parsed by tests)
title_th: ปรับข้อความ Phase 5 ใน ROADMAP เป็น "ขยายงาน #38" และเลิกใช้ชื่อ C05 โดยไม่เปลี่ยนรหัสที่ test อ่าน
sources: RM:L01..L05(note: roadmap text never updated for D-11)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: docs/ROADMAP-PART2-3.md Phase 5 still describes replacing Montenbruck & Gill; src/physics/propagator/propagate.ts:4 and docs/PHYSICS.md still name C05.

acceptance: Prose of Phase 5 says L01-L05 generalise src/physics/lunar/* and sim/apollo*; L01-L05 ids, table shape and plan.item.* keys unchanged; tests that parse ROADMAP-PART2-3.md and the in-app "coming next" lists pass unchanged.
quality_guard: ROADMAP-PART2-3.md is parsed by tests and drives section-plan lists: edit prose only, never ids/structure.
user_benefit: Future Moon work builds on the validated Apollo modules.

title: L01 General Moon ephemeris (Meeus ch.47 or embedded DE440 Chebyshev span) held to a Horizons fixture; gate for any Orbit Moon tool
title_th: L01 ตำแหน่งดวงจันทร์ทั่วไปทุกวันที่ (Meeus บทที่ 47 หรือ DE440) ตรวจกับ Horizons เป็นด่านก่อนเครื่องมือดวงจันทร์ใน Orbit
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: DE441 hourly table for Apollo 11's week only (src/physics/lunar/ephemeris.ts, src/data/ephemeris-1969.ts); any other epoch uses the low-precision series (src/physics/propagator/ephemeris-series.ts).
placement: new R sub-task R8.1 (Moon phase after G5)
priority_rationale: Owner keeps the Moon inside the Orbit plan (DECISIONS 2026-10-01) but PLAN priorities (ISS, cockpit) come first.
acceptance: Horizons 2000-2040 fixture <= 25 km RMS (Meeus) or <= 1 km (DE440 span); reuses lunar/ephemeris.ts API (no second copy, D-11); Apollo 11 tests against MSC-00171 unchanged; bundle budget recorded.
quality_guard: Apollo week keeps DE441 (bit-identical Apollo fingerprints); propagator Moon swap only with the D18 validated run.
user_benefit: A Moon that is right on any date, unlocking lunar tools.

title: L02 Central-body switching, lunar J2 and higher harmonics; frozen lunar orbits stay frozen
title_th: L02 สลับวัตถุศูนย์กลาง สนามโน้มถ่วงดวงจันทร์ระดับสูง และวงโคจรแช่แข็งรอบดวงจันทร์
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: src/physics/lunar/cislunar.ts one geocentric frame with Moon+Sun third bodies; lunar/gravity.ts degree-2 (J2, C22) only; no higher degree or frozen-orbit test.
placement: new R sub-task R8.2
priority_rationale: Needed for any general lunar orbit tool; after L01.
depends_on: RW:PHY-14 hyperbolic propagateKepler fallback replaced (physics group)
acceptance: GRAIL GL0660B to degree 8 (DP PHY-PH08-10); 27/50/76/86 deg frozen orbits hold e/omega over 1 year within stated bounds; Apollo results unchanged.
quality_guard: Apollo C01 path keeps its model unless a validated re-record is approved.
user_benefit: Realistic lunar orbits (why most lunar orbits are unstable).

title: L03 Getting there: TLI, free return, Chandrayaan phasing loops, LOI, NRHO planner (takes over C05)
title_th: L03 การเดินทางไปดวงจันทร์: TLI, free return, วงรอบปรับเฟสแบบ Chandrayaan, LOI และ NRHO
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: Apollo 11 TLI/MCC/LOI flown in src/physics/sim/apollo.ts; no free-return option, phasing loops or NRHO; no general planner.

priority_rationale: High teaching value but XL; after L01/L02.
depends_on: CR:NEW-PHYS-3 (owner decision on exact golden section; fidelity change)
acceptance: Planner held to Apollo 11 within 1 % and Chandrayaan-2 within 5 % (DP); Orbit Engineer only after L01 passes (D-11).
quality_guard: Reuse #38 modules; no second lunar propagator.
user_benefit: Students plan their own Moon transfer.

title: L04/L05 Lunar powered descent and return (TEI, lunar-return and skip entry, Artemis I) as general tools
title_th: L04/L05 การลงจอดบนดวงจันทร์และการกลับโลก (TEI, การกลับเข้าบรรยากาศความเร็วสูงและแบบ skip) เป็นเครื่องมือทั่วไป
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: Apollo-specific P63/P64/P66 descent (sim/apollo-descent.ts) and lunar-return lifting entry (sim/apollo-entry.ts); no skip entry; no "artemis" in src.
placement: new R sub-task R8.4 (deferred until R8.1-R8.3 and pilot demand)
priority_rationale: Apollo already covers the flagship case; generalisation only if wanted.
acceptance: Skip entry held to Artemis I published figures; descent reuses Apollo guidance with stated generalisation; Apollo fingerprints unchanged.
quality_guard: Apollo C01 results bit-identical unless an approved validated re-record.
user_benefit: Complete Earth-Moon-Earth missions beyond Apollo 11.

title: Chandrayaan-1 on PSLV-XL as a lunar Watch mission
title_th: ภารกิจ Watch Chandrayaan-1 บน PSLV-XL
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: no "chandrayaan" in src/ or tests/.

acceptance: Mission compared with ISRO published timeline; labelled per R4.4 quality labels.
quality_guard: Only after the PSLV-XL dossier passes R4.2; no fitted programme borrowed from another vehicle.
user_benefit: An Indian lunar mission flown on a vehicle already in the fleet.

title: Military/security content principle (public cited sources, consequences not operations) and the D-2 naming conflict of the rtaf-academy pack
title_th: หลักเนื้อหาด้านความมั่นคง (แหล่งเปิดที่อ้างอิง ผลกระทบไม่ใช่วิธีปฏิบัติ) และความขัดแย้งกับ D-2 เรื่องชื่อสถาบันในแพ็ก rtaf-academy
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: M01-M03 cite sources (VALIDATION section 7), no Space-Track/jamming code; but src/lessons/pack-sources/rtaf-academy.ts:31-48 ships "Royal Thai Air Force Academy" and the Thai academy name in the UI against DEC D-2; PLAN.md has no military rule.
placement: T (owner decision; pack edit by teaching group)

depends_on: Owner: written permission or rename (DEC D-2)
acceptance: Master plan restates the principle; either permission is recorded or the pack title/source text drop the institution names (EN/TH/RU) with lesson-pack tests green.
quality_guard: Rename must not change lesson content or grading.
user_benefit: The app can be used at institutions without implying endorsement.

title: GNSS geometry and DOP over a place (conceptual, geometry only; no jamming/spoofing simulation)
title_th: เรขาคณิต GNSS และค่า DOP เหนือสถานที่ (เชิงแนวคิด ไม่จำลองการรบกวนสัญญาณ)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: no dop.ts and no PDOP/GDOP/dilution in src (grep); GNSS group already in the satellite catalogue (src/provider/satellites.ts).

acceptance: DOM-free src/orbit/dop.ts: visible GNSS from the catalogue, sky plot, GDOP/PDOP/HDOP/VDOP/TDOP, 24 h curve, constellation removal and elevation mask; validated against closed form and a Skyfield/numpy fixture; sources on screen; EN/TH/RU.
quality_guard: Geometry only (P-10); runs in idle/worker for 24 h curves; no new runtime dependency.
user_benefit: Cadets see why satellite geometry limits positioning accuracy.

title: ASAT debris case studies 2007 (FY-1C) and 2021 (Cosmos 1408): consequences only, Gabbard diagram, lifetimes, conjunctions
title_th: กรณีศึกษาเศษซากจากการทดสอบ ASAT 2007 (FY-1C) และ 2021 (Cosmos 1408) เน้นผลกระทบ พร้อมแผนภาพ Gabbard
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: FY-1C debris group in catalogue and Watch tour (src/provider/satellites.ts, sky.about.debris); no gabbard.ts, no Cosmos 1408 group/case (grep); DEC D-15 still open.

title: HADR imaging-revisit scenario over Thai provinces (flood presets) using overflights and requirements tools
title_th: สถานการณ์ HADR: โอกาสถ่ายภาพซ้ำเหนือจังหวัดไทย (น้ำท่วมปี 2554/2562/2567) จากเครื่องมือที่มีอยู่
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: ingredients exist (src/orbit/overflights.ts, sensors.ts with 95 imaging satellites, imaging.ts, coverage.ts, src/design/requirements.ts); no HADR/disaster scenario (grep).
placement: T (T-MIL-1)
priority_rationale: Thai-context humanitarian use; mostly composition of validated tools, so good value per effort.
acceptance: Scenario runner: place, window, min GSD, radar acceptable -> first imaging opportunity per satellite; presets 2011 Chao Phraya, 2019 Ubon, 2024 Chiang Rai; uses M02 results unchanged (Object.is vs direct overflights call).

user_benefit: Students see how satellites support disaster relief in Thailand.

title: Snapshot staleness gate: red refresh step (not a blocked deploy) when asOf is older than N days; baseline-age test; in-app age warning
title_th: ตรวจข้อมูลเก่า: ให้ขั้น refresh แจ้งเตือนเป็นสีแดงเมื่อข้อมูลเก่าเกิน N วัน ทดสอบอายุ baseline และเตือนในแอป
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: deploy.yml cron moved to 43 17 * * * (done, LS-06); scripts/refresh-snapshots.ts:99 still only prints ::warning:: and keeps the old snapshot; no asOf age threshold or test; public/data/satellites.json baseline last committed 2026-09-26.
placement: Q (CI/data gate)
priority_rationale: Offline installs and repeated source failures silently ship ever-older element sets (passes, screening degrade).
acceptance: Refresh job fails (and opens an issue) when satellites/space-weather asOf > 3 days or IERS > 14 days, while the Pages deploy of code still proceeds with the kept snapshot; a unit test on committed baseline age with a documented refresh procedure; UI "data as of" badge turns amber beyond the threshold.
quality_guard: Never block an app-fix deploy because a data source is down (availability); never silently drop the snapshot fallback (RM:P3b).
user_benefit: Teachers notice old satellite data instead of trusting stale passes.

title: Offline data refresh kit for an installed dist (USB): refresh snapshots with --dist, restamp sw.js revisions, SHA256SUMS and build-info
title_th: ชุดอัปเดตข้อมูลแบบออฟไลน์ (USB) สำหรับโรงเรียนที่ไม่มีอินเทอร์เน็ต

placement: T (institutional distribution, with R7.2 release work)
priority_rationale: Valuable for closed-network pilots, but no pilot site is active yet (D-13).
acceptance: npm run snapshots -- --dist <path> writes the three JSON files, restamps sw.js precache revisions, SHA256SUMS and build-info; journey shows the new as-of offline; TH/EN instructions.
quality_guard: Service-worker integrity: revisions must match bytes, or clients keep stale caches; checksums regenerated.
user_benefit: Offline schools get fresh satellite and space-weather data without rebuilding.

title: Launch Library 2 dataset for upcoming/past launches
title_th: ข้อมูล Launch Library 2 สำหรับการปล่อยจรวดที่กำลังจะมา/ที่ผ่านมา
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: only a comment in src/provider/datasets.ts:6-10; no dataset, snapshot or rate limit.

title: Data provenance: in-app Sources page generated from data and a test that every numeric record has a source URL or an estimate flag (unsourced count only falls)
title_th: แหล่งที่มาของข้อมูล: หน้า Sources ในแอปที่สร้างจากข้อมูลจริง และ test ที่นับค่าที่ไม่มีแหล่ง/ไม่ติดป้ายประมาณการ

placement: PLAN R4.1 (catalogue and source ledger); orbit data (sensors, Thai satellites, templates) included

acceptance: tests/sources.test.ts: every numeric record in src/data has a URL or estimate flag, unsourced count pinned and can only decrease; #/sources (or About tab) lists sources per module in EN/TH/RU.

title: Data licences: credits test for NOTICE.md and settle NRLMSIS 2.1 / Cosmos 1408 / Wikimedia terms before use
title_th: สัญญาอนุญาตข้อมูล: test ตรวจ NOTICE.md และยืนยันเงื่อนไขก่อนใช้ NRLMSIS 2.1 / Cosmos 1408
status_evidence: origin/main da67341: NOTICE.md consolidates data terms (#44); no credits test; D-10/D-15 open.
placement: Q
